ideas.pitch: An industrial predictive maintenance node using the Shrike-Fi board's programmable logic to process raw high-frequency accelerometer vibrations and run local anomaly detection.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 1: Edge AI & TinyML - Build intelligent, on-device systems that can process sensor data and make predictions or decisions locally, such as predictive maintenance or anomaly detection.
ideas.title: EdgeVibe: FPGA-Accelerated Bearing Fault Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeting the Edge AI track with a hardware-software integration that heavily utilizes the unique FPGA capabilities of the Shrike-Fi development board, aligning directly with Vicharak's hardware platform.

ideas.pitch: A low-latency wearable glove and Shrike-Fi receiver combo that uses on-device edge AI to recognize emergency stop hand gestures, instantly cutting power to dangerous machinery via local wireless communication.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 1: Edge AI & TinyML - Build intelligent, on-device systems that can process sensor data and make predictions or decisions locally, such as gesture recognition.
ideas.title: GestureShield: Real-time Wireless Hand-Sign Machine Guard Interlock
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines a safety-critical industrial use case with an unusual physical build and live hardware demo, exactly matching the winning patterns from HardHack and industrial safety challenges.

ideas.pitch: A robust, low-power remote monitoring node using the Shrike-Fi's GPIO and wireless connectivity to log pH, turbidity, and flow rate, featuring edge-triggered automated diversion valves.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 2: Smart Systems, IoT & Automation - Develop innovative connected systems for real-world applications in industrial automation, environmental monitoring, or smart devices.
ideas.title: AquaNode: LoRa-Enabled Industrial Wastewater Flow and Heavy Metal Sentinel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses environmental monitoring directly with a complete closed-loop automation prototype that can be physically demonstrated live on a benchtop rig with water pumps and sensors.

ideas.pitch: A conveyor belt automation module driven by a low-resolution camera interface and the Shrike-Fi board to sort mixed metallic and non-metallic objects using custom programmable logic timing.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 2: Smart Systems, IoT & Automation - Develop innovative connected systems for real-world applications in robotics, industrial automation, or assistive technology.
ideas.title: RoboSort-Edge: Compact Conveyor Object Sorting via Shrike-Fi Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the unique blend of microcontroller computing and programmable logic on the Shrike-Fi board to drive stepper motors and high-speed sensors with minimal latency.

ideas.pitch: An integrated smart bicycle tail-unit that monitors road impact anomalies, automatically triggers an emergency mesh broadcast upon crash detection, and runs entirely on local kinetic-assisted power management.
ideas.problem_statement: Track 3: Open Innovation - Have an idea beyond the defined tracks? Propose your own project using the Shrike-Fi board across any domain.
ideas.title: VeloPulse: Kinetic Energy Harvesting Telemetry and Collision Responder for Cyclists
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent real-world personal safety problem with a physical wearable prototype that judges can physically hold, test, and trigger live during the evaluation.
